summary: Calculate external-pulse scalar pair production and a subsequent dephased electromagnetic population readout while preserving total psi index zero.

stage_events.description: The author requested continuation of the existing derivation and repair/merging of related repository work. No physical spectrum, substantive approval or discovery claim follows from this direction.

Apply the standard scalar-QED Sauter-pulse solution to declared physical-mode comparators; derive the hypergeometric equation, pair count generating function and collisionless readout from the same charged-particle Hamiltonian.

Compare exact hyperbolic, gamma-function and independent Klein-Gordon solutions without renormalizing the numerical Wronskian. Check gauge relabeling, weak-field powers, count statistics, energy derivatives and readout positivity/rotations.

Distinguish invariant pair occupation from a forbidden coherent nonzero harmonic, an energized medium from vacuum response, and delocalized Fourier modes from addressed multiverse segments. A static coil vector potential does not specify the electric pump.

evidence.supports: Conditional pair pumping and readout, exact/CAS/numerical controls and explicit domain/normalization limits.
evidence.limitations: External homogeneous pulse, free massive scalar pair evolution and dephased soft kinetic readout. No full momentum-integrated prediction, Maxwell apparatus, detector noise, formal Lean proof or experiment.

evidence.supports: The existing comparator, conserved harmonic mean, permitted neutral occupations and still-open physical source/readout projection.
evidence.limitations: These conditional calculations do not derive a final UBT action or physical positive-energy spectrum.

rejected_alternatives: Treat occupation modulation as coherent excitation of a nonzero conserved harmonic.
Use the spinor Sauter numerator in the scalar comparator.
Repair a failed numerical normalization by enforcing the Wronskian after integration.
Treat a constant pure-gauge A as a local pair pump or compare gauges at fixed mislabeled canonical momentum.
Confuse the mean pair number with a detection probability or an integrated number density.
Interpret a medium Drude response as a vacuum Proca photon mass.
Infer psi-localized transmitter/receiver segments from a uniform source acting on delocalized modes.

verification.limitations: Comparator/CAS/numerical verification only; Lean pending, no exhaustive independent human review, author attestation or experimental validation.

notes: Established quantum-field/kinetic methods applied to the current occupation-channel question. No new multiverse channel or exclusive conceptual-origin claim.
